_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Written for Raptor.
name: ntfy
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: ntfy sends push notifications to your phone or desktop from scripts with a simple HTTP request. Set an admin login and a default access to make topics private.
startup: if [ -n "${ADMIN_PASSWORD:-}" ]; then h=$(printf '%s\n%s\n' "$ADMIN_PASSWORD" "$ADMIN_PASSWORD" | ./ntfy user hash 2>/dev/null | grep -o '\$2[aby]\$[^ ]*') && export NTFY_AUTH_USERS="{{ADMIN_USERNAME}}:$h:admin" || { echo "Couldn't set up the admin login."; exit 1; }; fi; if [ -n "${NTFY_BASE_URL:-}" ]; then export NTFY_ATTACHMENT_CACHE_DIR=attachments; else unset NTFY_BASE_URL; fi; exec ./ntfy serve --config server.yml --listen-http :{{SERVER_PORT}} --cache-file cache.db --auth-file user.db --auth-default-access {{NTFY_AUTH_DEFAULT_ACCESS}}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# ntfy: downloads the ntfy server from its GitHub releases, checked
# against GitHub's SHA-256. server.yml, the users, the message cache and
# attachments are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
# Downloads unpack in a folder in the server's (the install's /tmp is
# small), removed when the script ends.
work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT

case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) arch=amd64 ;;
    aarch64) arch=arm64 ;;
    *) echo "ntfy has no build for this CPU ($(uname -m))."; exit 1 ;;
esac

version="${VERSION:-latest}"
[ "$version" = latest ] || version="v${version#v}"
# gh-release says why when the release doesn't exist or GitHub can't be reached.
tag=$(gh-release tag binwiederhier/ntfy "$version") || exit 1
name="ntfy_${tag#v}_linux_${arch}"

if [ -x ntfy ] && [ "$(cat .ntfy-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$tag" ]; then
    echo "ntfy $tag is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading ntfy $tag."
    gh-release download binwiederhier/ntfy "$tag" "$name.tar.gz" $work/ntfy.tar.gz
    tar -xzf $work/ntfy.tar.gz -C $work "$name/ntfy"
    install -m 0755 "$work/$name/ntfy" ntfy.new
    mv -f ntfy.new ntfy
    echo "$tag" > .ntfy-version
fi

if [ ! -f server.yml ]; then
    cat > server.yml <<'YML'
# ntfy's settings: https://docs.ntfy.sh/config/
# The port, address, default access, admin login and the files below are
# set by the server's settings, which win over this file.
behind-proxy: false
YML
fi
echo "Installed ntfy $tag."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The ntfy version to install, such as 2.38.0, or latest. Reinstall to change it.

variables.name: Default access
variables.description: What people without a login may do with topics: read-write, read-only, write-only, or deny-all.

variables.name: Admin username
variables.description: The admin's username, used when Admin password is set.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: A password for an admin who can use every topic. Leave it empty for no admin login.

variables.name: Base URL
variables.description: The address the server is reached at, including http or https. Needed for attachments and the web app's notifications.
